description: Pins scrcpy in mise.toml and documents device recipes (mirror, record, screenshot, logcat, Wi-Fi, deeplink).

notes: Beta: verified mise backends github:Genymobile/scrcpy and aqua:Genymobile/scrcpy list and install 5.0.1.

Device just recipes (devices, install, run, logcat, mirror, mirror-wifi, record, screenshot, clear-data, uninstall, deeplink) ship in the base template so they also work without this addon; this addon only pins scrcpy in mise.toml.
Launchbed does not download scrcpy at generate time; mise install fetches the official GitHub release when you opt into this addon or run mise use.
